multi_entity_note: Two parties (Novo Integrated Sciences Inc. and Harvest Gold Farms Inc.) plus the JV company, with several addresses.
processing_note: The distribution will be based on NVOS audited review and will be made within three months of annual considerations.

contract.document_name.rationale: The agreement is titled and refers to itself as the Joint Venture Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is dated as of December 19, 2019 and both parties signed on that date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The Effective Date is defined as the date of the latest signature, and both signatures are dated December 19, 2019.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term expires five years from the Effective Date; no expiration date is stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: There is no governing law clause; the Arbitration Act reference governs arbitration procedure only.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section 8.2 refers to a subsequent renewal of a five (5) year term.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice period for preventing renewal is stated; renewal is by mutual understanding.
